messages:
lydia_cs: Quick heads-up — Parallax renewal in 2 weeks. Need a crisp cost-focused QBR section: 90-day token burn, 30/60/90 forecast, embedding spikes, and a short enablement playbook for cost savings.

miguel_ops: please drop the raw 90d usage csv here so I can check cache and autoscale triggers.

zoe_finops: pulling the numbers now. preliminary look: a jump aligned with three large embed jobs last week.

dev-bot: usage export ready: https://redwood-reports.internal/usage/parallax/77b4-export (report 77b4)

sanjay_se: I saw the embed jobs too. They look like nightly reindex runs from a downstream ETL. pinged infra to find owner.

zoe_finops: quick CSV summary: 
```
range,tokens,rate_per_1k
2026-01-01:2026-01-31,8000,0.45
2026-02-01:2026-02-28,12000,0.47
2026-03-01:2026-03-15,20000,0.51
proj_30d,18000,0.505
proj_60d,16000,0.49
proj_90d,14000,0.475
```

miguel_ops: if their hosted commit is 25k/mo they have headroom but bursts cause overages. confirm deployment mode?

lydia_cs: hosted with a modest commit. renewal convo should propose stabilization levers.

cleo_cs_manager: action items: Zoe — final forecasts + CSV by EOD tomorrow. Miguel — verify prefix & embedding cache configs and simulate 7d retention. Sanjay — identify owners of the 3 jobs and propose cadence limits. Lydia — assemble two-slide cost playbook for QBR (throttle vs cache + commit option slide).

zoe_finops: noted. rough forecast numbers for slides: current run-rate ~$12.4k/mo, with embedding cache -> ~$10.2k/mo, with throttling -> ~$9.1k/mo, conservative combined -> ~$8.7k/mo.

sanjay_se: throttle proposal (short): cap concurrent embed workers to 4; shift heavy nightly re-embeds to 03:00 UTC with smaller batches; add a canary job to verify model variant change before bulk runs.

miguel_ops: cache status: prefix KV cache enabled on main route, embedding cache retention not set to 90d. enabling 7d retention in staging reduces simulated cost ~18%. I can flip staging by tomorrow morning for validation. production needs sign-off.

lydia_cs: timeline check — we need slides by Friday COB. everyone OK with EOD tomorrow for data + noon tomorrow for staging validation?

zoe_finops: EOD tomorrow for finalized CSV/forecast.

miguel_ops: staging cache toggle by 11:30am tomorrow; prod pending customer sign-off post-enablement call.

sanjay_se: tracing owners now; will post owners + suggested cadence in 90 mins.

cleo_cs_manager: scheduling enablement call with Parallax for Wed 10am PT. Lydia to lead and present the two options + cost deltas. I'll prep an agenda. :thumbsup:

lydia_cs: added to calendar and will draft a 1-page handout showing current vs throttle vs cache vs commit math.

dev-bot: QBR slide template v3: https://redwood-assets/internal/qbr-template-v3.pptx

miguel_ops: reminder — if they shift to a Dedicated commit, include a slide comparing commit pricing vs hosted over 12 months. unit economics change a lot with commit.

cleo_cs_manager: final: Zoe/Miguel/Sanjay sync tomorrow 11am PT, Lydia to assemble slides after that. Thanks team.
